Name: Magical Hub Farm
Author: ChincerDante
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a new farm type call Magical Hub, this is my first mod, bugs should be expected[/color]
The Farm layout is divided in four unique areas, the terrain takes a lot of space yet the advantages are plenty!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]this is a regular SMAPI mod please install the lastest version of SMAPI first.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
Unzip and place folder under the standard mod folder of your SMAPI/ stardew valley installation.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Start a new save and select "Magical Hub from your farm type selection.
[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Enjoy![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

Each area have at least enough space for proper sprinklers, different patches of soil are either 3x3 or 5x5 around, with a large area for a junimo hut but still less space than the basic farms, as well as terrain diminishing your ability to mass farm, hence the additional advantages to be offer:

Seasonal forageables spawn around the farm.

The mountain biome offers a Quarry. just like the hilltops farm.

[spoiler]As well as a cave Hotsprings and a shortcut after unlocking the steel Axe. (comes with a free lamp)
[center] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49501/49501-1784684129-190978205.png[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]
the plains and dense forest mirrors a standard farm and the forest farm., offers enough space for a whole junimo hut and after unlocking the steel pickaxe you get hardwood stumps in your little dense forest plus free mahogany.

[spoiler][center]The dense forest also includes a mini sunroom that works like a greenhouse with a 5x5 area for your crops. (comes with a free plushie)
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49501/49501-1784684125-27957816.png[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]
The beach not only offer forageables but also supply crates and blue grass, idea for your ranching needs. just like the beach and meadows farm.

At the center of the map you can find the Tower of magic, pre-decorated offering some space if you need it for casks or just hanging out, works as a nice central piece to the map, you can also place a bed here if you desire to sleep closer to everything (some decor cant be removed)
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49501/49501-1784684125-610395830.png[/img][/center]



[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher and Location Furniture mods[/color]

Manifest.Description: A modified map with four unique zones each with its own advantages and a few secrets.
